**6402 Ekkocardiografi** is a specific medical procedure code registered in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (National Health Service Register) in Denmark. It is utilized to identify and track [[ekkokardiografi|echocardiography]] examinations as part of the national clinical quality measurement program for patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. 

Within the Danish healthcare system's quality assurance framework, managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), precise coding is essential for calculating clinical indicators. The code 6402 is one of several designated identifiers used to capture echocardiographic procedures. According to the national guidelines for atrial fibrillation quality indicators, the Sygesikringsregisteret contains a specific set of echocardiography codes, which include 2208, 3810, 3811, 5101, 5102, 5103, 6402, 6408, and 0906 [^src1]. These codes collectively ensure that diagnostic imaging for AF patients is systematically recorded and evaluated across regions.

The ongoing use of this code is documented across multiple annual reports of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), appearing consistently in the technical definitions for quality indicators from 2023 through 2025 [^src1] [^src2] [^src3]. By standardizing the identification of these procedures, code 6402 helps healthcare authorities monitor diagnostic wait times, assess adherence to evidence-based clinical standards, and ultimately improve cardiovascular care for the AF patient population. Other related procedure codes in this registry include [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], and [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], among others.
